rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for describing an impressive or astonishing manner.

example.english: They solved the problem in five minutes, amazingly.
example.traditional: 佢五分鐘就解決咗條數，真係好犀利。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ng5 fan1 zung1 zau6 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 tiu4 sou3 zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6

rows.note: Use this colloquial intensifier before an adjective when the meaning is ‘extremely’.

example.english: It is amazingly cold today, and I don’t even want to go outside.
example.traditional: 今日勁凍，我都唔想出街。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ging6 dung3 ngo5 dou1 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this when something is surprisingly or unusually the case, especially when it is difficult to believe.

example.english: Amazingly, he is so clever that even the teacher can't believe it.
example.traditional: 估唔到佢仲出奇地叻，連老師都唔信。
example.jyutping: gu2 m4 dou2 keoi5 zung6 ceot1 kei4 dei6 lek1 lin4 lou5 si1 dou1 m4 seon3
